title: syom oracle provenance
notes: Ordinary cargo test must not invoke ffmpeg/FDK. Historical lavc s16 goldens keep their committed bytes; missing engine versions are gaps, not guesses. PNS comparisons are statistical/tool, not cross-RNG waveform identity.

policies.deterministic: bitstream byte-exact and/or PCM vs committed s16: max abs <= 2 LSB, SNR >= 55 dB (typical 1 LSB / 70-80 dB)
policies.pns_stochastic: PNS/noise tools: energy, codebook and lavc-LCG agreement where claimed; do not force waveform identity across RNGs
